text_block_list.name: Dreamy Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, Chrono-san, Bouquet-san. Every time I 
see you two, you look so lovely..."

text_block_list.name: Dreamy Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Those sorrowful eyes of hers are 
lovely too... I wonder what they're 
talking about?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Chrono-san— So you felt the same way after 
all.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
W-Well, on my last road trip, I just kind 
of... All the races I wanted to watch were 
in the morning, so I thought I'd check out 
the track food in the afternoon, but—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"It seems... I indulged a bit too much. To 
think I would... gain this much weight..."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"I just wanted to help out a fried-food 
shop that's on the verge of closing."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Since I've been visiting every single day, 
I've gotten a bit, well, plump all over.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"Let us combine our strengths to overcome 
this crisis. Working together will surely 
yield better results than standing alone."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Yes, Bouquet-san... For this once, let us 
steel our hearts against each other. Think 
of it as saving... our future selves...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
If it is for Chrono-san's sake— then I 
shall become a demon without hesitation.

text_block_list.name: Dreamy Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, both of them holding hands... How 
utterly magnificent...!

text_block_list.name: Dreamy Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
I'm not quite sure what they're up to, 
but... let's cheer them on as well...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward—thanks in part to their mutual 
support, Chrono Genesis and the others 
successfully reached their target weights.
